runes.name: Fehu
runes.title: Beginning
runes.energy: Beginning, genesis, spark, the arising of an idea, the arising of an event or an idea, a new beginning.
runes.where: A thought appeared — it wasn't there a minute ago.
runes.what: Write it down. Don't act yet. Let the idea travel further.
runes.feel: A new thought, idea, spark has appeared. It's not clear yet where it leads, but it already exists.
runes.error: Acting immediately without passing through the stages of choice and confirmation.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.title: Multiplicity
runes.energy: Multiplicity of variants, energy, a whirl, swirling.
runes.where: Your head is spinning with 100 possibilities.
runes.what: Gather data. Don't choose. Just observe.
runes.feel: Your head is a mess. A hundred options, eyes darting everywhere. You're in a whirlwind of possibilities.
runes.error: Trying to choose right now without gathering enough data.

runes.name: Thurisaz
runes.title: Choice
runes.energy: Confirmation of the choice, concentration on a specific option, cutting away excess options, an edge, an awl, the point in the question of choice.
runes.where: You say 'yes' to one thing and 'no' to the rest.
runes.what: Make the choice. Without it you'll be stuck in Uruz.
runes.feel: You say "yes" to one and "no" to the others. You cut away the excess.
runes.error: Fearing to cut options and staying in Uruz.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.title: Confirmation
runes.energy: Reinforcement (confirmation, clarification) of the choice, receiving approval, wisdom, the "voice from above".
runes.where: An inner or outer sign that the choice is right: a 'green light' from an authority, a mentor, or your inner voice.
runes.what: Lock it in. Say out loud: 'Yes, I chose this.'
runes.feel: Confirmation of the best choice: the wisdom of the 'voice from above' or a green light from yourself and the world.
runes.error: Ignoring the sign, not getting approval from yourself or the world.

runes.name: Raidho
runes.title: First Step
runes.energy: Start, a jerk, a push, the transition into motion, the moment of the birth of motion.
runes.where: The moment between 'I want' and 'I do'. You have overcome the inertia of rest.
runes.what: Take the smallest possible action. Don't wait for the perfect moment.
runes.feel: Fear is behind you. You've started moving. The hardest step is done.
runes.error: Waiting for the perfect moment, postponing the start.

runes.name: Kenaz
runes.title: Manifestation
runes.energy: Manifestation, materialization, bringing to light, appearance, making explicit (visible), enlightenment.
runes.where: The idea became visible. You can touch it.
runes.what: Show it to the world. Bring it out of the shadows.
runes.feel: The idea became visible. You can touch it. The result has appeared.
runes.error: Not showing the result, keeping it to yourself.
steps: Bring it out of the shadows

runes.name: Gebo
runes.title: Harmony
runes.energy: Harmony, balance, equilibrium, a handshake (merging in harmony), the balance of what is envisioned over time (what is and what should be).
runes.where: The new and the old have agreed: what is and what ought to be are in balance.
runes.what: Keep your connections. Don't burn bridges.
runes.feel: The new and the old have come to terms. Balance is achieved.
runes.error: Destroying old connections, burning bridges.

runes.name: Wunjo
runes.title: Joy
runes.energy: Completion of a stage, joy, satisfaction, an exhale, a result.
runes.where: A short happiness. Done. An exhale.
runes.what: Enjoy it. But don't get stuck — Hagalaz is next.
runes.feel: The quiet joy of a finished job, not euphoria: you sit down, exhale, and smile.
runes.error: Getting stuck in the joy, not moving on.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.title: Living with the Result
runes.energy: Fulfillment of a wish (in any form), collision with reality, living with the result, the Result of Wunjo made permanent.
runes.where: The euphoria has faded. The result has become a constant: you live with it — the car gets dirty and needs gas.
runes.what: Embrace daily reality. Hagalaz is a mirror of your creation's quality.
runes.feel: The euphoria is gone, the daily routine begins. The granted wish became routine — that is not a failure, that is living with the result.
runes.error: Panicking or treating a clash with reality as failure.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.title: Signal
runes.energy: Need, the need for change, relentless progress, discomfort as the need to act, a signal for change, a "crack", the desire to change.
runes.where: Something rubs and bothers you. Not a catastrophe yet — but 'the old no longer works'.
runes.what: Hear it. Don't ignore the small pain.
runes.feel: Discomfort as a need to act: something has to change.
runes.error: Ignoring the discomfort.

runes.name: Isa
runes.title: Pause
runes.energy: Concentration, stopping, freezing, gathering strength, a pause, concentration on the time of "what is happening".
runes.where: The world has frozen. Ice has dammed the river — so that in spring the water flows anew.
runes.what: Take a pause. Don't act. Gather your attention.
runes.feel: You are not running — you gather strength and attention. Meditation in the midst of the storm.
runes.error: Freezing in the pause forever.

runes.name: Jera
runes.title: Insight
runes.energy: Sudden insight, an excellent result, an ideal conclusion, a successful thought, a result as a reward, the harvest of effort.
runes.where: A flash. 'That's it!'
runes.what: Write the insight down. It won't repeat itself.
runes.feel: A flash. 'Exactly!' The decision came by itself — a reward for the stages you have passed.
runes.error: Not writing it down, not using the insight.

runes.name: Perthro
runes.title: Second Chance
runes.energy: A second chance, a new beginning based on old experience in the time of what is, initiation.
runes.where: You're not starting from zero. You use old experience.
runes.what: Don't chase the new. Look at the old with fresh eyes.
runes.feel: You are not starting from zero — it is a spiral turn. You use old experience for a new result.
runes.error: Starting over from scratch, ignoring experience.
steps: Use the old in a new way

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.title: Experience in Action
runes.energy: Realization of a second chance, drawing benefit from accumulated experience, action based on an old resource, a bridge from idea to deed, like the last kilometer before the finish of the race.
runes.where: Fixing an old car in a new way.
runes.what: Use what you already have. Don't mine for new things.
runes.feel: You fix the old car in a new way. It is the bridge from idea to action — the last kilometer before the finish.
runes.error: Ignoring accumulated experience.
runes.next: Algiz — protection of the new state

runes.name: Algiz
runes.title: Protection of the New State
runes.energy: Protection of the new state, reinforcement, insurance, possibly as a connection with the higher "I", a form of the manifestation of intuition.
runes.where: Shield and antenna: the new state is protected and insured. You sense danger in advance.
runes.what: Trust it. Verify it. This is awareness, not paranoia.
runes.feel: Perhaps a connection to the higher Self: a form of manifestation of intuition. The inner voice says 'stop'.
runes.error: Ignoring the inner voice.
runes.next: Sowilo — victory with the ideal outcome

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.title: Victory with the Ideal Outcome
runes.energy: Victory with the ideal outcome, an ideal solution, an ideal thought, wholeness, experience as form.
runes.where: The cycle is complete. Victory with the ideal outcome: the right decision, the perfect thought.
runes.what: Record what you've learned. This is your light.
runes.feel: You have become whole: a victory after which you will never be the same. The experience stays with you as form.
runes.error: Not recording the experience.

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.title: Concentration of Will
runes.energy: Manifestation of the potential of previously accumulated experience, the symbol of the beginning of the end, concentration of will.
runes.where: You throw the spear at the target: the manifestation of the potential of previously accumulated experience.
runes.what: Act without doubt. But only if you have the experience.
runes.feel: An act of will: you put all your accumulated strength into one movement. A symbol of the beginning of the end — the final phase has begun.
runes.error: Acting without experience.

runes.name: Berkana
runes.title: New Form & Status
runes.energy: Rebirth, growth, a new form and a new status, nurturing.
runes.where: Something new is born from the action, and your status changes: you become a mother, the product ships.
runes.what: Don't rush. Nurture the new and settle into your new status.
runes.feel: Something new is born from the action: pregnancy, product launch, daily care. And the question: who are you now in this new status?
runes.error: Rushing, not letting the new form take root.

runes.name: Ehwaz
runes.title: The Lift & Bridge
runes.energy: Movement, a change of state, exchange, partnership, a lift, a bridge, the transfer of an event.
runes.where: The event is carried to a new level: a move and a change of state — in tandem with a partner or the outside world.
runes.what: Use the bridge and the partnership. Do not leap across by force — trust the lift.
runes.feel: Movement in tandem: you sync with another person or system. The event is carried to a new level.
runes.error: Trying to go it alone: Ehwaz never works without a pair, a bridge, and an exchange.

runes.name: Mannaz
runes.title: Confirmation of Rebirth
runes.energy: Confirmation of the rebirth of an event, returning to oneself renewed, society, reason.
runes.where: The event has been reborn, and society confirms it. You look in the mirror — and recognize yourself, renewed.
runes.what: Lock in the confirmation. Acknowledge that the rebirth has officially occurred.
runes.feel: The old 'I' has died — a new one is born. 'I am a programmer,' and the colleagues agree: society accepts you in your new quality.
runes.error: Doubting the confirmation, denying that the rebirth took place.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.title: Rebirth in the Flow
runes.energy: Rebirth, a flow, the course of life, the subconscious, trust.
runes.where: Control is released. The water of the subconscious brings the answer.
runes.what: Trust the current. Row with the oars, but don't fight the river.
runes.feel: Control is released. The old form has dissolved. The water carries the answer.
runes.error: Fighting the river or turning passive; blocking rebirth with hypercontrol.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.title: Multiplicity & Potential
runes.energy: A multiplicity of forms of fertility, potential inside a form, a seed.
runes.where: The result already exists inside the form — like a book at the printer or a seed in the ground.
runes.what: Show patience. Don't try to dig up the seed prematurely.
runes.feel: The result already exists within the form — like a book at the press or a seed in the soil. A spectrum of possibilities opens up.
runes.error: Digging up the seed prematurely out of impatience; prematurely narrowing choices.
steps: Hold the potential within the form

runes.name: Othala
runes.title: Inheritance & Connection
runes.energy: Inheritance, connection, tradition, that which is passed on.
runes.where: Ingwaz sprouted and bore fruit. The estate you did not create but own: the fruits are yours and of those who come after.
runes.what: Accept the gift. Accept the responsibility of passing it on.
runes.feel: The business goes to your son, the notes to a student in ten years. The bond of generations: what is passed on.
runes.error: Not accepting the gift and not passing it on.

runes.name: Dagaz
runes.title: Rebirth of the Cycle
runes.energy: Rebirth, transformation through a shift of polarity, completion of the cycle, enlightenment.
runes.where: Day has replaced night. The old has finally gone, the new has come. The cycle is complete.
runes.what: Open the door. Full rebirth is the threshold of a new Fehu.
runes.feel: The butterfly has left the cocoon. Enlightenment: the morning of a new day, an open door to a new turn.
runes.error: Fearing the open door, lingering at the threshold.
runes.next: A new Fehu — a new beginning
